Works available in this collection include Twenty years after, Camille (La Dame aux Camilias), The Hero of the People: A Historical Romance of Love, Liberty and Loyalty. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.

sourceTitle: The Son of Clemenceau, A Novel of Modern Love and Life
description: "The Son of Clemenceau: A Novel of Modern Love and Life" by Alexandre Dumas is a novel likely written during the late 19th century. This story serves as a sequel to "The Clemenceau Case" and delves into themes of love, social class struggles, and personal identity against a richly detailed backdrop of urban life, specifically set in Munich.
